info.name: SonarQube Cloud Web authentication hotspots API
Change the status of a Security Hotpot. Requires the 'Administer Security Hotspot' permission.

params.name: comment
params.value: This is safe because user input is validated by the calling code

params.name: resolution
params.description: Resolution of the Security Hotspot when new status is REVIEWED, otherwise must not be set.

params.name: status
params.description: New status of the Security Hotspot.

items.docs: Change the status of a Security Hotpot. Requires the 'Administer Security Hotspot' permission.

params.name: fileUuids
params.description: Comma-separated list of file uuids. Returns only hotspots found in those files. If set, 'files' must not be set.

params.name: files
params.description: Comma-separated list of file paths. Returns only hotspots found in those files. If set, 'fileUuids' must not be set.

params.name: hotspots
params.description: Comma-separated list of Security Hotspot keys. This parameter is required unless projectKey is provided.

params.name: onlyMine
params.description: If 'projectKey' is provided, returns only Security Hotspots assigned to the current user

params.name: projectKey
params.description: Key of the project or application. This parameter is required unless hotspots is provided.

params.name: ps
params.description: Page size. Must be greater than 0.

params.name: resolution
params.description: If 'projectKey' is provided and if status is 'REVIEWED', only Security Hotspots with the specified resolution are returned.

params.name: sinceLeakPeriod
params.description: If '%s' is provided, only Security Hotspots created since the leak period are returned.

params.name: status
params.description: If 'projectKey' is provided, only Security Hotspots with the specified status are returned.
